scientific_integrity.detail: The Skill makes no fabricated numerical claim. Its redundancy, signed-NES, and S4-class boundaries remain precisely stated.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is offline visualization of researcher-supplied enrichment objects; it does not provide patient-level diagnostic or treatment advice.

methodological_ground.detail: The new source note correctly scopes the compareClusterResult treeplot failure as version-specific and directs a re-test after enrichplot/ggtree upgrades.

code_usability.detail: M4: the designated supported Windows R 4.4.3 / Bioconductor 3.20 runtime materialized a valid canonical two-page PDF but did not complete. Its owned R child continued growing to 1,798,709,248 bytes RSS after output, never wrote the runner exit marker, and was stopped after positive process-tree identification. Direct Rscript reproduced a post-load access-violation exit -1073741819. The available isolated WSL R 4.5.2 runtime has none of clusterProfiler, enrichplot, org.Hs.eg.db, GOSemSim, ggplot2, ggridges, or ggupset, so it is not a supported substitute and was not modified. The remaining six dynamic executions were therefore not claimed as fresh successes.

functional_suitability.note: ORA, GSEA, and compareCluster visualization routes are explicit; the tip's re-test trigger keeps the known treeplot limitation bounded to its stated version context.

reliability.note: Prerequisites, class dispatch, optional dependencies, empty-result escape hatch, and expected failure modes are explicit.

performance_context.note: Focused documentation and a compact usage guide keep operational detail near the examples.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, object contracts, encoding definitions, and stop conditions are actionable.

human_usability.note: The quick start is readable, though the main description remains S4-class-heavy.

security.note: No credentials, raw command execution, sensitive-data handling, or destructive operation is documented.

maintainability.note: The source change is a precise upstream re-test condition and removes duplicated prose; snapshot SHA-256 matches source: 267DF27BD8FA82B4D1788AC0A54FAB3B33C1C816A4616F489B903E9F288150B1.

agent_specific.note: The Skill supplies class-specific alternatives and refuses invalid bare-data.frame coercion rather than inventing enrichment slots.

recommendations.problem: The only designated package-complete Windows runtime crashes/hangs after materializing output; WSL R has no required packages.
recommendations.root_cause: Runtime/platform failure outside the documentation-only source diff, not a claim that the source's R code is syntactically invalid.
recommendations.fix: Provision or identify a private, package-complete R runtime (clusterProfiler, enrichplot, org.Hs.eg.db, GOSemSim, ggplot2 and optional plot dependencies), then rerun all seven inputs and the two shipped examples before promotion.
